snapshot.title: Pancreatic Treatment Center Public Signal Snapshot
snapshot.scope_note: China Top 30 candidate centers plus selected international pancreatic centers in the United States, Japan, and Europe.
snapshot.methodology_note: Candidate ordering is based on public signal strength from official hospital pages, center pages, public news, guideline participation, disease-specific center status, and disclosed scale metrics. It is not a clinical ranking.
snapshot.disclaimer: This dataset is for product demo, source registry, and research triage. It is not medical advice, hospital endorsement, or treatment-quality ranking. Surgery and patient-volume metrics preserve period, scope, definition, and source status where available.
collection_notes: Medinsh site search was attempted through Tavily and web search but returned no usable indexed results for this snapshot.

wechat-article-search skill was attempted for Ruijin, Jiangsu Provincial People's Hospital, and Fudan Cancer Center, but the local script failed because the cheerio dependency is missing. No WeChat article results are used as scale evidence in this snapshot.
WeChat signals are therefore left as pending unless an official hospital page itself exposes an official WeChat channel.

2026-06-13 second pass added Shanghai Zhongshan Hospital and Shanghai First People's Hospital as user-specified Shanghai pancreatic resources; the China Top 30 remains a public-signal candidate list, not a clinical ranking.
